# Credentials

The commands `mt help` lists under Credentials. More in [Credentials and credential stacks](../../../concepts/credentials.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`credential-apply`](#credential-apply) | Create or update credentials and stacks from a JSON file, with keys read from environment variables (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`credential-delete`](#credential-delete) | Delete a model credential and take it out of every credential stack (tenant admins only) |
| [`credential-get`](#credential-get) | Show a model credential: its endpoint, keys by hint (never the keys) or sign-in, models and health |
| [`credential-list`](#credential-list) | List the tenant's model credentials: provider, kind, key hints (never the keys) and health |
| [`credential-stack-default`](#credential-stack-default) | Show the default credential stack (the tenant's, or a namespace's with `--namespace`), or change it with `--set` or `--clear` |
| [`credential-stack-get`](#credential-stack-get) | Show a credential stack and its entries in the order they're tried, with each entry's rules |
| [`credential-stack-list`](#credential-stack-list) | List the tenant's credential stacks (the ordered credentials a run may use), marking the tenant's default |
| [`credential-test`](#credential-test) | Test a model credential's keys without running a model and show each result (exits 1 if it fails; tenant admins only) |

## credential-apply

Create or update credentials and stacks from a JSON file, with keys read from environment variables (tenant admins only).

```text
mt credential-apply [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--file, -f <value>` | text | yes |  | JSON file on your disk: {"credentials": [{"name", "provider", "endpoint"?, "tag"?, "models"?, "keys": [{"fromEnv"}]}], "stacks": [{"name", "entries": [{"credential", ...}]}]} |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Say what would change, and change nothing |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it reads a file and environment variables on this computer, and the cloud shell has neither.

## credential-delete

Delete a model credential and take it out of every credential stack (tenant admins only).

```text
mt credential-delete <credential> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<credential>` | text | yes |  | The credential's id or name |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## credential-get

Show a model credential: its endpoint, keys by hint (never the keys) or sign-in, models and health.

```text
mt credential-get <credential>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<credential>` | text | yes |  | The credential's id or name |

## credential-list

List the tenant's model credentials: provider, kind, key hints (never the keys) and health.

```text
mt credential-list [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--tag <value>` | text |  |  | Only the credentials with this tag |

## credential-stack-default

Show the default credential stack (the tenant's, or a namespace's with `--namespace`), or change it with `--set` or `--clear`.

```text
mt credential-stack-default [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | Show or change this namespace's default (id or name) instead of the tenant's |
| `--set <value>` | text |  |  | Make this credential stack the default, by id or name (tenant admins only) |
| `--clear` | flag |  |  | Clear the default (tenant admins only) |

## credential-stack-get

Show a credential stack and its entries in the order they're tried, with each entry's rules.

```text
mt credential-stack-get <stack>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<stack>` | text | yes |  | The credential stack's id or name |

## credential-stack-list

List the tenant's credential stacks (the ordered credentials a run may use), marking the tenant's default.

```text
mt credential-stack-list
```

## credential-test

Test a model credential's keys without running a model and show each result (exits 1 if it fails; tenant admins only).

```text
mt credential-test <credential>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<credential>` | text | yes |  | The credential's id or name |
